subject.name: Conventional hydroelectric dam and powerhouse cross-section
identity_constraints: The subject must be a conventional hydroelectric dam / powerhouse system unless the variant explicitly asks for pumped storage.
It must include water as the energy source.
It must include a dam/reservoir relationship or explicitly state if using run-of-river.
It must not become a coal, nuclear, geothermal, tidal, or generic factory power plant.
It must not show combustion engines or smokestacks as the primary generation mechanism.

rendering_requirements.target_graphic: labeled technical cross-section of a conventional hydroelectric dam and powerhouse
rendering_requirements.view: side cross-section through dam and powerhouse
rendering_requirements.background_policy: background landscape is allowed only if it does not obscure the cross-section or labels
rendering_requirements.logo_policy: avoid logos unless explicitly allowed by later policy

geometry: Reservoir must be upstream and higher than the downstream tailrace for a conventional dam cross-section.
Intake must connect reservoir water to the penstock.
Penstock must carry water from the intake toward the turbine.
Turbine must be downstream of the penstock and inside or near the powerhouse.
Generator must be mechanically coupled to the turbine, not floating in the reservoir.
Transformer and transmission lines must be on the electrical-output side, not in the water path.
Spillway must be distinct from the penstock/turbine path.
Tailrace must receive water after it passes through the turbine.
Water-flow arrows must not contradict gravity/head unless the variant is pumped storage.

component_location.reservoir: upstream and higher than tailrace behind dam wall
component_location.dam wall: retains reservoir water and creates head
component_location.penstock: pipe or conduit from intake to turbine
component_location.turbine: downstream of penstock inside or near powerhouse
component_location.generator: dry or housed, mechanically coupled to turbine
component_location.transformer: electrical-output side connected to transmission line
component_location.spillway: separate overflow route distinct from penstock/turbine path
component_location.tailrace: downstream water channel after turbine discharge

style: flow arrows must remain legible and directionally consistent

required_label_trace.generator: dry/housed electrical generator coupled to turbine

approval_contract.guardrail: Uncertainty must produce needs_review, not approval.
